baseVariables.name: base-accent-color
baseVariables.usage: Primary accent — selection, drop-zones, focus rings, debug panel. Tints derived via color-mix().

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Drop-invalid border, danger context-menu items, scroll-highlight arrows

baseVariables.name: base-main-bg
baseVariables.usage: Used for --ltree-light (context-menu hover tint, debug stat chips)

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Default border color (checkbox, context-menu, spinner track)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-1
baseVariables.usage: Primary body text color (node labels, context-menu items)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Muted text (path, toggle icon, loading 'more', node-path)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-4
baseVariables.usage: Subtle text (context-menu shortcut, submenu arrow, divider label)

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-on-accent
baseVariables.usage: Text on accent backgrounds — checkbox checkmark color

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-xs
baseVariables.usage: Small text — node path, context-menu shortcut, icon font-size (multiplier × --ltree-rem)

baseVariables.name: base-font-size-sm
baseVariables.usage: Default node text and context-menu items (multiplier × --ltree-rem)

componentVariables.name: ltree-rem
componentVariables.usage: Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default 10px). Set to 1rem to scale with document font-size.

componentVariables.name: ltree-primary
componentVariables.usage: Primary accent color (selection, focus, links). Tints derived via color-mix().

componentVariables.name: ltree-danger
componentVariables.usage: Danger color (drop-invalid, scroll-highlight arrows, danger menu items)

componentVariables.name: ltree-light
componentVariables.usage: Light surface (context-menu hover, debug stat chips)

componentVariables.name: ltree-font-family
componentVariables.usage: Font family for all tree text

componentVariables.name: ltree-node-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between node icon and label

componentVariables.name: ltree-node-content-padding
componentVariables.usage: Inner padding of a node row

componentVariables.name: ltree-children-margin-top
componentVariables.usage: Top margin of nested child list

componentVariables.name: ltree-toggle-icon-size
componentVariables.usage: Toggle icon (chevron / +/- / arrow / leaf) SVG size

componentVariables.name: ltree-toggle-icon-width
componentVariables.usage: Width reserved for the toggle column

componentVariables.name: ltree-toggle-icon-margin-right
componentVariables.usage: Gap between toggle and node content

componentVariables.name: ltree-checkbox-border-width
componentVariables.usage: Checkbox border thickness (hairline, does not scale)

componentVariables.name: ltree-checkbox-focus-ring-color
componentVariables.usage: Focus-visible ring color (defaults to a 25% tint of --ltree-primary)

componentVariables.name: ltree-checkbox-focus-ring
componentVariables.usage: Composed focus-visible box-shadow (uses the two parts above; override directly for full control)

componentVariables.name: ltree-highlight-anchor-width
componentVariables.usage: Left-border width on the Shift+click anchor node

componentVariables.name: ltree-highlight-anchor-color
componentVariables.usage: Left-border color on the Shift+click anchor node

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-glow-size
componentVariables.usage: Glow border thickness (hairline, does not scale)

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-size
componentVariables.usage: Direction arrow size in glow mode

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-position
componentVariables.usage: Horizontal arrow position (% of node width)

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-child-rotation
componentVariables.usage: Arrow rotation for 'child' position (45deg by default)

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-before-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'before' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-after-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'after' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: ltree-drop-arrow-child-image
componentVariables.usage: SVG data URL for the 'child' direction arrow

componentVariables.name: tree-ghost-bg
componentVariables.usage: Touch drag ghost background (legacy prefix, kept for backward compat)

componentVariables.name: tree-ghost-color
componentVariables.usage: Touch drag ghost text color (legacy prefix)
